verdict.rationale: mise is a CLI with a dedicated continuous-integration guide. The guide covers a scripted install (`curl https://mise.run | sh` then `mise install`), an official mise-action that installs and caches tools, lockfile-based `mise install --locked`, `MISE_SAFE=1` for safe non-interactive runs, and tasks meant for CI to run consistently. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of CI use (one community comment notes friction mapping mise task dependencies into GitHub Actions workflows), and no documented way to generate CI workflow files.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: we provide a mise-action that wraps the installation of mise and the tools
mise-action installs mise and the tools declared in the checked-out repository. By default it also caches the tools
Commit a lockfile and install with `mise install --locked`. Every job then installs the same versions
set MISE_SAFE=1 so that project configuration cannot execute code
Use tasks for builds, tests, linters, development servers, and other commands you want teammates and CI to run consistently.
A committed wrapper can install mise on demand, avoiding a separate installation step in each pipeline.
